name: Morinaga Azuki
source: A new driver. The next day after getting her driving license, she gets into an accident and hits [url=/c6926]Seiji[/url]. They decide to reach an agreement instead of going to the police, but Azuki wasn't ready for what Seiji wanted as compensation.
